title: Decode stored per-item data per item in a batch read
rule: When a batch API reads a stored blob per face or per file (a cmap bitset, JSON coverage, a parsed record), decode each item on its own: an item whose blob cannot be decoded gets the same answer as an item with no stored data (and a warn log), and the other items are answered. Only an unknown id or a database error fails the request. Do not `?` a decode error inside `.map(...).collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()`. Add a test that damages one item's blob beside a healthy one and asserts the healthy one is still answered.
rationale: E4.5 (#63): `Index::sample_texts` used `face_cmap(face)?` inside a collect, so one face with a damaged stored cmap failed the whole request and every on-screen face lost its fallback.
